name: Basalt
summary: A running and outerwear house after rain: one full-bleed campaign photograph of the piece worn and moving, the product name in a light grotesk and the next drop as one quiet line under it; then the pieces large in a carousel with what's left in each size, close-ups at full width, today's weather as one sentence, the run club as a wide photograph over three columns. Basalt grey ground, bone text, wet-rock steel as the only accent; Host Grotesk light for names, Rethink Sans for everything else. For clothing brands that sell drops and want to look like a big house.
